note: Generic industry profile, NOT a specific researched business -- unlike Nick's Plumbing & Air Conditioning, no named firm was researched here. All facts below are industry-wide statistics gathered during the original candidate-business research pass (2026-08-13), before Nick's Plumbing was selected as the full-build demo business.

facts.fact: 81% of law firms admit losing business because of slow responses.
Only 25% of law firms respond to online leads in under 5 minutes; 26% never respond to an online lead at all.
One in three calls to law firms is never answered live.
70% of law firms lack a structured follow-up process for leads.
A prospective client contacting multiple firms selects the first one to respond about 68% of the time.

pain_points.description: Missed and slow-answered calls, plus a lack of structured follow-up, cost solo/small firms new business industry-wide.
pain_points.evidence: Industry-wide statistics above are verified; whether they apply to any specific unnamed firm is an inference by design, since no specific firm was researched for this seeded profile.

automation_opportunities.opportunity: AI-assisted intake triage: answer/log every inbound lead (call or web form) immediately, draft a same-day follow-up, and flag anything needing an attorney's direct attention.
automation_opportunities.rationale: Directly targets the two largest verified gaps -- unanswered calls (1 in 3) and missing follow-up (70% of firms) -- with the same structural pattern already proven in the Nick's Plumbing build (AI draft, human-approval gate before anything client-facing goes out).
